purpose: Real-world source-info corpus for structured hard filtering followed by persistent multilingual-e5-small retrieval inside SandboxDB. These records are grounding evidence and candidate facts. They complement, but do not replace, task-specific workflow records.

real_world_ratio_policy.reason: Personalized retrieval depends on hard-filterable semantic candidate records; file-size ratio would encourage meaningless data padding.

included_data: Open-Meteo /v1/forecast daily forecast snapshots for configured world cities
excluded_data: calendar alarms/events tied to synthetic persons
music favorites tied to synthetic persons
source_policy.reason: Included sources are public/catalog/weather/transport snapshots suitable for offline retrieval. Excluded sources are personal, sensitive, or tied to individual synthetic accounts.

files.record_format: JSONL, one SandboxSourceInfo.v2 object per line
